_schema.name: SERIES_LOG
_schema.purpose: Index of every calendar window in a scheduled series. Regenerated from the per-run result.json files; references their hashes and never restates their numbers as an independent computation. This file is an index, not a measurement — its own hash is not registered and carries no claim.
invariants: One record per calendar window in the operating period, with no gaps and no omissions.
A window that produced no label appears with evaluation_status NOT_EVALUATED and label null. It is never absent.
N_calendar_total = count of all records. N_classified_total = count of records with evaluation_status EVALUATED. Label frequencies are computed over N_classified_total only.
Values are copied from the referenced result.json, never recomputed. If a value here disagrees with the file it references, the file is authoritative and this log is regenerated.

Records are append-only. An unclassified record (NOT_EVALUATED — INCOMPLETE_SET) may be updated exactly once under the S1 §2.5 single retry rule upon generation of its initial result.json during cycle W+1. Otherwise, an existing record is rewritten only when its underlying result.json is regenerated.

spec_commit: <commit SHA pinning M, C, S, INSTANCE_ISOLATION, PARAMS and code together>

baseline_window._note: Rolling. Differs per record by construction — S1 3.3. A record's M1 values are not readable without this block.

zones._note: R is per zone and per record. Quoting M1 without R and its baseline_window is prohibited — S1 3.3.

companions._note: Descriptive only. Never enters N_elevated and never affects the label — C 3.

classification._note: N_total is the full comparison set. It is never scaled down to the measured subset — C 3.2.

records._note: The completeness account is published even though no measurement exists. Which zone failed, and by how much, is the finding for this window.
